definitions.mae_r: Maximum gross adverse price excursion through exit, nonnegative; includes exit fill, caps intrabar lows/highs at stop.
definitions.mfe_lower_r: Known gross favorable excursion before exit; full previous bars, exit open and fill.
definitions.mfe_upper_r: Also includes the entire intrabar stop-bar favorable wick; an upper bound only.
definitions.scope: Original full universe, before retrospective bottom20 exclusions; 1H frozen entry replay, preserves 19 December2022 entries.
definitions.cost: Original 20bp round trip for net R; excursions are gross price marks, not account leverage PnL.
definitions.controls: Original matched random returns reused; excursion distributions are descriptive, no strategy-change or causal claim.
